skill.label: PCCS：明度グラデーション判定

derivationRule: The current official Grade 3 sample defines a value gradation by changing lightness stepwise and states that this can create a sense of movement or flow. This text-only training slice operationalizes that rule as a sequence of abstract lightness levels that changes strictly in one direction; it does not claim that the numbers are PCCS/Munsell measured values.

questions.prompt: 次の明度レベルの並びのうち、明度を一方向に段階的に変化させたものを選んでください。
questions.sentence: 次の明度レベルの並びのうち、明度を一方向に段階的に変化させたものを選んでください。
questions.explanation: 明度が2→4→6→8と一方向に段階的に高くなっています。明度を段階的に変化させる配色が明度のグラデーションです。

qa.independentRecheck: parsed every abstract lightness sequence and selected the unique strictly monotonic sequence before comparing with proposedAnswer
